list.title: Branches and locations
list.description: The farm and its selling points. Each branch has its own locations, stock and document numbers.
list.emptyBody: Add the farm first, then each selling point.
list.denied: You do not have access to branches

form.newBody: A farm, shop or selling point with its own stock.
form.editBody: The code is set when the branch is created and cannot change.
form.codeHint: Two to five capitals or digits, such as KAS. It appears in document numbers.
form.codeRule: Use two to five capital letters or digits.
form.name: Name
form.phoneRule: Enter a phone number, such as 024 412 3456.

detail.error: The branch could not be loaded
detail.closeBody: The branch stops trading. Its stock, documents and history stay, and it can be reopened.
detail.closeConsequence: The server may refuse, for example if this is the last active branch. If it does, its reason appears here.

locations.title: Locations in this branch
locations.description: Pens, cold rooms, stores and shop floors where stock is held.
locations.emptyBody: Add where stock is held: a pen, the cold room, the shop floor.
locations.denied: You do not have access to locations
locations.newBody: Where stock is held in this branch. To move a location from another branch, ask for it to be added to the contract (CR-014).
